in_sanskrit.name: Kuna
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Black
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kuna एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kona’, meaning ‘black’ or ‘dark’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Kuna or Kunj Bihari, representing darkness or the hidden aspects of the universe.
